title: ChoiceConflict: code and supplement for 'Racing to Control Decision Conflict'
description: Code, supplementary materials and figures for Heathcote, Metz, Stevenson and Matzke, 'Racing to Control Decision Conflict'. Five evidence-accumulation models (LBA, RDM, LNR, WDM, DDM) of simple choice and of the Simon, Stroop and attention-network tasks (data: Eisenberg et al., 2019), fitted hierarchically with EMC2/DMC2. The release holds one entry point per stage (data, classification, model selection, floors, predictives, figures, model recovery), a local fitting driver, and the supplement (Word, with its Markdown and LaTeX source). The fits, data, predictives, plot-ready tables and the source tarballs of the eleven EMC2/DMC2 builds that made the fits are in the companion data record.
